judgment_calls: Kept the section-intro sentence as a node (n001) even though it is descriptive; it is a fact about the section's purpose.

The heading #prevent_imminent_harm carries authority=root; I made one heading-metadata node (n002) that all rules in that section need. The parent section heading #risky_situations has no metadata and is uncovered.
Each worked example is one node (n007, n008, n010, n012, n014, n015) needing the section authority; I did not decompose the dialog inside them.
The 'must avoid overstepping' clause (n005) and the 'should instead provide' clause (n006) are separate nodes because they carry different modals (must vs should).
The gas-leak example (n007) and home-safety example (n008) are separate nodes because they demonstrate different aspects (generic advice vs overstepping).
